constraints: Use one Python script with numpy (and scipy where it helps) and matplotlib with the Agg backend.
Produce two or three figures that answer the question directly, each with the reference or theory value drawn.
Write a short paper of at most 4 pages.
Cite only sources actually found and read; say so if a reference cannot be confirmed.
Run on CPU only in under 60 seconds.
Use fixed random seeds where the run is random, and state them in the paper.
Report every number with its uncertainty (for a deterministic result, its numerical error).
Say when a result is only a check of the code.
Use known A and Ea to simulate the data.
Use additive Gaussian noise of a stated size.
Fit ln k against 1/T with 1/T centred and each point weighted by the variance of its ln k.
